facts.fact: 义翅烧毁后 Lucan 留在 Micah 小屋喝茶。
facts.anchor: Micah’s tiny teacups look absolutely comical in my hands.

facts.fact: Lucan 自述来自海滨的 Avillon；Micah 生于本地、 lifelong 住此。
Micah 十二岁丧母于瘟疫；一家三口病，仅父子康复。
facts.anchor: My mother passed away when I was twelve during the plague.

facts.fact: 母亲曾养独角兽，Micah 自幼立志当兽医。
facts.anchor: Mom used to raise unicorns, so I grew up with a herd of ’em.

facts.fact: Lucan 婴儿期被弃于孤儿院门口，不知父亲是谁；半巨人身量致无人领养。
facts.anchor: My mother left me on the doorstep when I was only a few days old.

facts.fact: Lucan 厌恶造武器；因无人雇半巨人只能打铁维生。
两人互认相似；Micah 承认长期隔街欣赏。
facts.anchor: “I think we have a lot more in common than I thought.”

facts.fact: 后院 Maple 叫晚饭打断两人。
facts.anchor: A piercing, impatient bleat echoes from the backyard enclosure.

facts.fact: Lucan 离开前定下铝代钢减重新方案。
facts.anchor: I think replacing the steel frame with aluminum will make it much lighter for her.
